title: Best app for routines!
body:
I love, love, love Routinery! I have autism and ADHD and struggled so much with routines. I love structure, but I hate repetition. I needed my routines to be flexible and easy adjustable. Also I wanted to have analytics to give me insights on what is working and what not so I can change my routines accordingly and also look back and feel good about my accomplishments.

I have been using it for three weeks every morning without fail. Also it helped me with doing my household tasks in bits. Never been so productive and able to keep up!

Only thing I don’t like is that recently in the analytics per routine you can not see the days when you did each to do, but only how often you did it in the past week. Would love to have both or have the option to switch these views as both are valuable for me.

Keep up the awesome work though! See myself using this app for a very long time!

title: Glitchy
body: I really liked the app and used it for almost a year. I did have to cancel my subscription because it was too glitchy. Often my phone app wouldn’t start up, I’d have to delete and download the app again for it to work. On my Apple Watch, the routines would go out of sync or just not register when I finished a routine or tapped to move to the next section. Wrote the creators about it, but they didn’t have an answer or a solution (they offered some tips and were very quick in their response). Ultimately, it created additional friction to use routinery and didn’t work for me.
author: Ierjwz

title: Pur
body: I’m not a morning person at all and struggle allot with getting up in the mornings, but this app motivates me to actually get out of bed on time and not just rot for another 2 hours. Ive been using it for about half a year now and I think it’s really nice how you can track and form multiple personal routines. The app has a very nice design and there are thankfully no annoying ads or anything like that in the app. If you only use it for a morning and/or evening routine, the free version is just enough. You could buy the paid version but the app doesn’t constantly force you to do so which is nice as well. The quotes that randomly pop up above the routines are very cute too. Overall I love this app so I recommend!!

title: App keeps closing and sometimes doesn’t register finished routines
body:
I’ve been using this app for a few days now and it really does help me with keeping up a steady daily routine. I have it on my iPad (to make new routines and edit easily), iPhone and Apple Watch and I start the routines easily on my Apple Watch so I can keep a quick eye on how much time I have left and what my next task is. 

However, I’ve noticed that finished tasks on my Apple Watch don’t register on my iPad, even though my account is synced and the making of routines does sync quickly. I can’t check if it’s registered on my iPhone (which is directly linked to my Apple Watch) because whenever I open the app, it immediately crashes and closes. I really, really like the idea but I can’t keep using it if these bugs don’t get fixed.
author: louisianababies

title: 1+1 scam??
body: I saw the “1+1 promotion” for the new year and it was written there that I’ll get 6-months subscription + 6-months gift code. I thought I would be able to use the 12 months of subscription in total (using the gift code for additional 6 months) so I purchased it, but after I purchased it I found out that the gift code expires in only 3 months and I myself can’t use it (because my subscription ends in 6 months). Anybody would think they can use the gift code themselves if it’s written as “1+1”, and besides, the promotion didn’t mention anywhere that the gift code is going to expire in 3 months. This is very misleading and deceptive. I’ve been using the app for a long while now and didn’t expect that they will deceive the user with this kind of scheme. Very disappointed.
